I was at one time inclined to hold, that Kâlidâsa", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "had borrowed this Stanza from Bhartṛihari, as such a supposition", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "would have absolved both writers of the charge of plagiarism.[*]", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "Prof. R. G. Bhâṇḍârakar suggests another theory. He contends", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "that the Stanza in question is one of those Subhâshitas which are", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "floating about in popular talk. According to him, this Stanza would", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "be, both in the Nîtis'ataka and in the S'âkuntala, a mere reproduc-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 10, "text": "tion of a part of what may be called the literature living in the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "mouths of respectably educated people. As I have remarked in", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "the place whence these remarks are summarized,[†] I accept", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "this theory, and also its application to the Stanza now before us,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "although I ought to say, that I do not accept its application here", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "without some little misgiving. Perhaps I may take this oppor-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 16, "text": "tunity of adding, that when the original remarks above epitomis-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 17, "text": "ed were written, I had slightly misunderstood Prof. Bhâṇḍâr-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 18, "text": "kar's view. We are much more in agreement than I then", "end": "space"}, {"n": 19, "text": "thought, for, as I learn from him, he did not and does not mean", "end": "space"}, {"n": 20, "text": "to contend that the theory propounded by him is universally", "end": "space"}, {"n": 21, "text": "applicable, but only when collateral circumstances suggest its", "end": "space"}, {"n": 22, "text": "application.",
